description: Look up a local service business (plumber, HVAC, electrician, roofer, contractor) on ServiceFront and answer from owner-verified facts: hours, service area, contact and owner-confirmed prices. Uses ServiceFront's read-only MCP server: no sign-in, no API key.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
